summary.result: Overall, the wetland system was found to be adequate for treating polluted water stream with stable removal efficiency even during the winter period.
summary.background: In this study, the field experiment to reduce nonpoint source pollution loadings from polluted stream waters using wetland system was performed from June 2002 to March 2004.
